update.requiredDescription: This version is no longer supported. Reload the application to continue.

registrationClosed.title: Registration is closed
registrationClosed.description: Creating new accounts is paused for now. If you have an account you can sign in.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Settings that affect everyone on this installation. Every change you make is written to your security log.

announcement.title: Announcement
announcement.description: A short message shown to everyone at the top of the application.
announcement.bothRequired: Write a message in both languages.

registration.title: New accounts
registration.openDescription: When off, the registration form is hidden and the server refuses new registrations. Existing accounts are not affected.

releases.title: Releases
releases.description: The record of published versions of the applications. The server neither builds nor hosts applications; this record tells clients that a new version exists and where to get it.
releases.downloadUrlHint: Must start with https. Not needed for the web version.
